test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All blazers are dungarees.

2. No dungaree is scarf.

3. All pyjamas are dungarees.

**Conclusions:**

I. No blazer is scarf.

II. No blazer is pyjama.

III. Some blazers are pyjamas.

options.text: Only conclusion I and III follow
Only conclusion I and II follow

solution:
**Given statement:**

1. All blazers are dungarees.

2. No dungaree is scarf.

3. All pyjamas are dungarees.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bc763579d2cfb7de8585ce7390d2b39043e75fffa924ed40e583dfad69cac7a.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No blazer is the scarf.→ **True** (As no dungaree is scarf and Blazers are the subset of dungaree. So no blazer is the scarf.)

II. No blazer is pyjama.→ False (As we have no direct and definite relationship between blazers and pyjamas, we can not conclude any relation between them.)

III. Some blazers are pyjamas→ False (As we have no direct and definite relationship between blazers and pyjamas, we can not conclude any relation between them.)

Thus** "Only Conclusion I follows".**

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2).**
